name: KAZE (風)
tagline: A small static site generator in one Python file
description: Kaze builds agency and small-business sites from JSON and Markdown using only the Python standard library.

about.title: About
about.description: Why Kaze exists and who maintains it.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Report bugs, ask questions, or suggest changes on GitHub.

blog.title: Articles
blog.description: How Kaze works, how to edit content, and how to deploy it.

services.title: Nothing to install
services.description: Runs on Python 3.8 or newer with the standard library only. No pip, no virtualenv, no lockfile to keep updated.

services.title: One file you can read
services.description: The whole generator is build.py, under 500 lines. When something breaks, you can find the cause yourself.

services.title: Content as files
services.description: Pages are JSON and Markdown in your Git repo. Edit them in any editor, or optionally through Sveltia CMS.

services.title: Plain static output
services.description: The output is HTML, CSS, and a small script in dist/. Host it on anything that serves files.
